definitions.explanation: The size and depth of a person's vocabulary, especially in the context of language learning or communication skills.

examples.japanese: {単語力|たんごりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ね⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
⟦{読解|どっかい}→読解：15056_dokkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{単語力|たんごりょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{左右|さゆう}される→左右される：26073_sayuusareru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Reading comprehension scores are often influenced by vocabulary ability.

examples.japanese: ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{単語力|たんごりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{十個|じゅっこ}⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: To improve my English vocabulary, I try to learn ten new words every day.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧ (word, vocabulary) and {力|りょく} (power, ability). Commonly used in language learning and test preparation contexts. The {〜力|りょく} suffix is productive in Japanese, forming many ability-related compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {単語力|たんごりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to build vocabulary
- {単語力|たんごりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧: to expand vocabulary
- {単語力|たんごりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: to lack vocabulary
- {単語力|たんごりょく}⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧: vocabulary test

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{語彙力|ごいりょく}→語彙力：09906_goiryoku⟧: vocabulary ability — a more formal synonym; ⟦{語彙|ごい}→語彙：14214_goi⟧ is the academic term for vocabulary while ⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧ is more casual
- ⟦{読解力|どっかいりょく}→読解力：09290_dokkairyoku⟧: reading comprehension ability — another {〜力|りょく} compound for a language skill
- ⟦{表現力|ひょうげんりょく}→表現力：21315_hyougenryoku⟧: expressive ability — the skill of putting thoughts into words
